clue.text: Foot has now become a Tory back-bencher

definitions.meaning: one who goes on foot is a pedestrian
Peter ..., the Conservative cabinet minister, returned to the back benches

explanation.definitionFit: A pedestrian is someone on foot, and Peter Walker was a well-known Conservative MP of the day.

clue.text: Review calculations after office hours apparently

parts.note: work is the figuring shown in a sum, the calculations
after office hours the working day is over

explanation.surface: Someone checks their sums in the evening once the office has shut.
explanation.definitionFit: To go over something again thoroughly is to review it.

clue.text: Final Ruritanian romance is the sole remaining possibility

explanation.surface: A final swashbuckling adventure novel is presented as one's only chance.
explanation.walkthrough: Ruritania is the imaginary kingdom of The Prisoner of Zenda, whose author was Anthony Hope.
explanation.definitionFit: When every other chance has gone, what is left is the one remaining expectation.

clue.text: Pound entering EMS liable to that Dutch disease

indicators.note: the pound sign goes into the letters of the monetary system's initials

parts.note: L, from libra, is the abbreviation for a pound

explanation.surface: Sterling joins the European Monetary System, open to some Dutch ailment.
explanation.walkthrough: EMS was the European Monetary System; the disease is Dutch elm disease, which killed most of Britain's trees of this kind.
explanation.definitionFit: Dutch elm disease is a fungal blight that attacks only these trees.

clue.text: Stick by your decision to buy Irishman a drink

definitions.meaning: to refuse to change one's position
to stand someone a drink is to pay for it, and Pat is the stock Irishman

explanation.definitionFit: To refuse to budge is the poker idiom, and treating Paddy to a pint is the literal reading.

clue.text: Main service cut by American petrol rationing

definitions.meaning: the utility delivered by a gas main
Americans call petrol gas, so its rationing curbs this delivery

explanation.definitionFit: A gas main carries the utility to houses, and in America gas means petrol, so rationing restricts it.

clue.text: Northern diggers supposing to believe anything

parts.note: Australian soldiers are diggers, and they served in the AIF, the Australian Imperial Force

explanation.surface: Miners from the north are supposedly credulous.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Supposing' links the wordplay to the definition, whose sense is someone ready to believe anything.
explanation.definitionFit: A naive, unsophisticated person is credulous and readily taken in.

clue.text: Pay the money even though house is not yet fully built

definitions.meaning: to hand over what is owed

definitions.text: even though house is not yet fully built
definitions.meaning: a house partly erected is ...

explanation.definitionFit: Handing over the cash is paying up, and a half-finished building stands only partly raised.

clue.text: Give warning that cigarette filter has been removed

definitions.meaning: to alert someone in advance

definitions.text: that cigarette filter has been removed
definitions.meaning: the tip of a cigarette is its filter, so with it gone the tip is off

explanation.definitionFit: Alerting someone discreetly is a warning, and a filter-less cigarette has lost its end.

clue.text: Again start work on a summary

definitions.meaning: to carry on after a break
a précis or brief account of something

explanation.definitionFit: Restarting after a pause is the verb sense; a précis is the noun sense, from the French.

clue.text: Permit one journey in which you don't check the speed

parts.note: permit means let
I is the Roman numeral one
a journey is a trip

explanation.surface: Someone is allowed one outing on which no speed limit applies.
explanation.definitionFit: The idiom means to go flat out without restraint.

clue.text: What conductors have to do if fiddling is suspected

definitions.text: What conductors have to do if fiddling is suspected

parts.words: What conductors have to do if fiddling is suspected
parts.note: conductors suggests orchestra leaders and fiddling violins, but it reads as being held to account for fraud

explanation.definitionFit: The idiom means to accept the unpleasant consequences of one's actions, as a cheat must when found out.

clue.text: Hoot wildly is what Romans did when he succeeded

definitions.text: Hoot wildly is what Romans did when he succeeded

indicators.note: wildly says the letters of the noise are thrown into disorder

explanation.surface: Rome greeted a new emperor's accession with jeering.
explanation.walkthrough: The emperor succeeded Galba in AD 69, the year of four emperors, and lasted only three months.
explanation.definitionFit: He was the Roman emperor who seized power after Galba's murder.

clue.text: For many South Africans their place of birth

definitions.text: For many South Africans their place
definitions.meaning: the South African province now KwaZulu-...
relating to being born

explanation.definitionFit: It was a South African province, and the adjective describes anything to do with being born.

clue.text: An expert way to polish metal

definitions.meaning: an enthusiast who knows a subject well
to rub up to a shine

explanation.definitionFit: A connoisseur is an enthusiast, and rubbing with a soft cloth shines metal.

clue.text: Words Cyril composed

indicators.note: composed suggests putting something together, so the man's name is rearranged

explanation.surface: A man named Cyril has written some lines.
explanation.definitionFit: The words of a song are its text.

clue.text: Fourth man was not sharp enough

definitions.meaning: Anthony ..., the fourth man of the Cambridge spy ring
dull-edged, unable to cut

explanation.definitionFit: Anthony Blunt was exposed as the Cambridge spies' fourth man, and a dull edge cannot cut.

clue.text: They make most noise when refused permission to load cargo

definitions.text: They make most noise when refused permission to load cargo

parts.words: They make most noise when refused permission to load cargo
parts.note: the proverb about hollow containers and loud talkers is dressed up as ships turned away from loading

explanation.definitionFit: The proverb says those with least to say make most noise, like hollow containers that clang.

clue.text: A wonderful era enjoyed by centenarians

definitions.meaning: a splendid period of time
people over a hundred have lived a very long time

explanation.definitionFit: Living to a hundred is reaching an advanced span of years, and a splendid epoch is a glorious period.

clue.text: Nothing in details being amended and detached from the rest

indicators.note: in places the round zero inside the other word
being amended says the letters are altered into a new order

parts.note: nothing is zero, the letter O

explanation.surface: Some particulars are corrected and kept apart from everything else.
explanation.walkthrough: 'in' puts O inside DETAILS, and 'being amended' rearranges the result.
explanation.definitionFit: Something set apart and alone is cut off from everything around it.

clue.text: How to welcome friends who are not carrying concealed weapons

definitions.meaning: with a warm embrace

definitions.text: who are not carrying concealed weapons
definitions.meaning: arms here are weapons, openly displayed rather than hidden

explanation.definitionFit: A warm embrace greets friends, and weapons carried openly are not hidden.

clue.text: Servant in a country that is tropical but not very hot that is

definitions.text: Servant in a country that is tropical

parts.note: not very hot means cool
ie is the abbreviation of id est, that is

explanation.surface: A domestic works in a land with a mild tropical climate.
explanation.definitionFit: The word was used for hired labourers in India and the Far East.

clue.text: An American naval vessel that is really Australian

parts.note: USS, United States Ship, prefixes American naval vessels
ie is the abbreviation of id est, that is

explanation.surface: A US warship turns out to have come from Down Under.
explanation.definitionFit: It is the informal word for someone from Australia.

clue.text: Work preparing soup

indicators.note: preparing suggests making up a dish, so the letters are made up afresh

explanation.surface: Making a pot of soup is a job of work.
explanation.definitionFit: A composer's numbered composition is a piece of work.

clue.text: Fish tested by its odour?

definitions.meaning: a small silvery food fish
sniffed, in the past tense of the verb to sniff out

explanation.definitionFit: It is a small edible fish, and it is also the past tense of sniffing something.

clue.text: Boat's left way back

indicators.note: back says the two pieces together are read from the end

explanation.surface: A vessel has been left far behind.
explanation.definitionFit: It is a two-masted sailing vessel.

clue.text: Samoan capital worth half of a piastre

indicators.note: half of says only the opening half of the letters in these two words is wanted, the rest dropped

explanation.surface: A Pacific city's value is put at a fraction of a small coin.

clue.text: He gets record assistance

parts.note: LP is a long-playing record

explanation.surface: A man receives a disc as aid.
explanation.definitionFit: Aid given to someone is support.

clue.text: Previous job blown at the end of the day

parts.note: previous means last, as in last week

parts.note: the buds on a potato are its eyes
a plot of ground is a patch

explanation.definitionFit: A pad worn over one organ of sight covers it.

clue.text: Savoury paste likely to produce middle-age obesity

definitions.meaning: something put on bread, such as a meat or fish paste
the thickening waistline of middle years

explanation.definitionFit: A paste for bread is put on thinly, and middle-age expansion is the familiar thickening waist.
